items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Marshall. But he didn't play professionally.

ctx.x: Marshall. But he didn't play professionally. They would -- my mother used to give parties and they would have so many people that would come out, like from the city, and stay all night, you know, stay like the weekends, and I used to see all the pretty girls that would come out there, you know, and they were so popular with the girls and things and that made me want to be a musician, too. That's another thing. Oh, there are many things, along with my auntie had a hotel in Dallas, Texas, and when I'd go -- she…
When you were growing up then, you were on this farm?
